verdict.rationale: Gitleaks is a secret-scanning CLI tool, not an agent, so it could plausibly ship an official MCP server and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an MCP server, hosted MCP endpoint, or any agent-connection interface. It documents only CLI commands, pre-commit hooks, and a GitHub Action, and the probes found no llms.txt or OpenAPI spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
